description: The life of one Folketinget case or bill as a timeline: its number, title and summary, current status, every stage in date order (introduced, readings, committee report, deadlines, adopted) with each stage's status, the votes held at each stage with their conclusion, and the documents filed on the case (title, date, type, document id for document_text). Give case number + session (e.g. "B 36", 20261) or the numeric case id. Danish text. Source: Folketinget, case register.

case.description: Case number as printed, e.g. "B 36", "L 12". With session (default: current).

case_id.description: Numeric case id (Sag id), instead of case + session.

max_documents.description: Max documents to list (default 40, max 100); documents_total gives the full count.

name: folketinget_dk_bill_timeline
title: Folketinget Dk Bill Timeline
